Q: Excel - Extract 2 characters after specific text in string A:

The following formula with REGEX gives the result (see below)

=REGEXEXTRACT(A1,"(?<=Power:).{2}")

INPUT OUTPUT
Every 2 Hours Power:123 Sail:0 SWC:3 BCR:0 CJC:0 CU:0 CSC:0 12
Every 2 Hours Power:12 Sail:0 SWC:3 BCR:0 CJC:0 CU:0 CSC:1 12
Every 2 Hours Power:1 Sail:0 SWC:3 BCR:0 CJC:0 CU:0 CSC:2 1

This will always return any two characters after the specified text.

Q: Video capture on AR (Vuforia) with unity in Android platform A:

We released a Unity gameplay recorder plugin built on top of the native screen recording frameworks of Android and iOS. Because it relies on the platform’s native recording APIs (MediaRecorder for Android, and ReplayKit for iOS), it provides stable performance while capturing the full device screen.

The plugin can record anything visible on the screen, including gameplay running in AR environments such as Vuforia or AR Foundation.

Features

  • Full device screen recording

  • Record with or without microphone audio

  • On Android, it can also record system/app audio

  • Multiple recording configurations supported

  • Native performance on both platforms

  • Integrate it within seconds
